entries.title: Lanternfall is now on games.radgh.com
items: Lanternfall is now on games.radgh.com — go down through the drowned city of Vessmere and relight its six Great Lamps.
Build your own spells from a Flame, a Shape and Charms; water, wax, oil, fire, steam and sand all react to them.
Pick your class, save at lamp-posts, and fight your way down to each act's boss.
This What's new list is here now, on the title screen and in the pause menu.
Best with a keyboard and mouse. Phones can open the menus but cannot play yet.
